screen.welcomescreen.spell_wheel.hint: Let go of %s on a spell to cast it, click it to read what it does

spell.welcomescreen.fireball.desc: Launches an exploding fiery sphere toward your target. Sets foes ablaze and deals area damage.
spell.welcomescreen.fire_wall.desc: Erects a wall of searing flames in front of you. Blocks enemy movement and burns anyone passing through.
spell.welcomescreen.magma_grip.desc: Encases the target in hardening molten rock. Immobilizes the victim and burns them over time.
spell.welcomescreen.dragons_breath.desc: Unleashes a torrent of scorching draconic fire. Incinerates all enemies caught in the fiery cone.
spell.welcomescreen.fire_pillar.desc: Erupts a towering column of fire beneath your target. Blasts victims skyward and sets them alight.
spell.welcomescreen.meteor_strike.desc: Calls down a devastating shower of fiery meteors. Decimates a massive area with repeated explosive impacts.
spell.welcomescreen.living_bomb.desc: Brands a foe with an unstable volatile curse. The target violently detonates after a delay, harming nearby enemies.
spell.welcomescreen.fiery_lash.desc: Flogs the area ahead with a whip of pure flame. Slashes through groups of enemies with swift fire damage.
spell.welcomescreen.infernal_scythe.desc: Slashes with a colossal 3D scythe of obsidian and magma. Cleaves in a sweeping arc, igniting and burning all foes in front.
spell.welcomescreen.ice_lance.desc: Fires a sharp spear of glacial ice at high speed. Deals heavy piercing damage and inflicts deep slowness.
spell.welcomescreen.blizzard.desc: Summons a fierce blizzard over the target area. Continuously freezes and damages all trapped enemies.
spell.welcomescreen.frost_nova.desc: Releases a freezing radial burst around you. Immobilizes and damages all surrounding hostile creatures.
spell.welcomescreen.ice_wall.desc: Creates a thick barrier of solid blue ice. Obstructs enemy pathing and projectile attacks.
spell.welcomescreen.ice_barrier.desc: Envelops your body in a durable coating of frost. Absorbs incoming attacks and chills attackers.
spell.welcomescreen.glacial_spire.desc: Forces a jagged 3D ice crystal obelisk to erupt from the bedrock. Impales targets upward with heavy frost damage and deep freezing.
spell.welcomescreen.lightning_strike.des: Calls a focused lightning strike down onto your target. Shocks the victim and nearby foes with high voltage.
spell.welcomescreen.ball_lightning.desc: Launches a slow-drifting orb of concentrated electrical charge. Continuously zaps adjacent enemies as it travels.
spell.welcomescreen.chain_lightning.desc: Discharges an arc of lightning that jumps between targets. Rapidly shocks up to four nearby enemies.
spell.welcomescreen.thunderclap.desc: Slams the atmosphere with a deafening sonic rupture. Knocks back surrounding enemies and interrupts their actions.
spell.welcomescreen.lightning_bolt.desc: Fires a high-speed bolt of azure electricity. Instantly strikes and damages the targeted enemy.
spell.welcomescreen.static_shield.desc: Surrounds you with an electrified defensive aura. Shocks any attacker who dares to strike you in melee.
spell.welcomescreen.mjolnir.desc: Hurls the mythical 3D Norse warhammer into the fray. Unleashes a lightning blast and sonic shockwave on impact, then boomerangs back into your hand.
spell.welcomescreen.water_jet.desc: Blasts a high-pressure torrent of water forward. Knocks back enemies and extinguishes active flames.
spell.welcomescreen.tidal_wave.desc: Surges a crashing wave forward in a wide line. Sweeps enemies away and deals blunt impact damage.
spell.welcomescreen.aqua_prison.desc: Traps the target within a pressurized bubble of water. Immobilizes and suffocates the enclosed creature.
spell.welcomescreen.whirlpool.desc: Generates a swirling aquatic vortex on the ground. Pulls nearby entities into its center while inflicting damage.
spell.welcomescreen.healing_rain.desc: Manifests a rejuvenating rain cloud above. Continuously restores health to all allies standing within.
spell.welcomescreen.poseidon_trident.des: Plunges a golden 3D sea trident from the heavens into the earth. Triggers an explosive oceanic geyser that sweeps enemies away.
spell.welcomescreen.earthquake.desc: Ruptures the earth around you with violent tremors. Deals damage and stumbles all nearby ground enemies.
spell.welcomescreen.boulder_toss.desc: Hurls a massive boulder directly at your foe. Smashes on impact dealing heavy physical trauma.
spell.welcomescreen.stoneskin.desc: Hardens your flesh into durable granite. Provides high damage resistance and knockback immunity.
spell.welcomescreen.earth_spikes.desc: Causes sharp jagged spikes to erupt from the ground. Impales enemies caught in the straight line ahead.
spell.welcomescreen.sandstorm.desc: Conjures a swirling whirlwind of abrasive sand. Slows hostiles and disrupts their vision.
spell.welcomescreen.terra_drill.desc: Deploys a spinning 3D bedrock and iron drill along the ground. Grinds through enemy lines with continuous crushing damage.
spell.welcomescreen.wind_gust.desc: Blasts a fierce gale directly outward. Strongly repels enemies and pushes away threats.
spell.welcomescreen.cyclone.desc: Spins a turbulent air vortex around your position. Deflects incoming arrows and pushes hostiles back.
spell.welcomescreen.tornado.desc: Unleashes a violent roaming vortex. Sweeps up nearby enemies and hurls them into the air.
spell.welcomescreen.levitate.desc: Ascends upward riding a column of air currents. Grants great vertical mobility and slow gliding descent.
spell.welcomescreen.gale_barrier.desc: Forms a pressurized barrier of swirling wind currents. Mitigates attacks and boosts your movement speed.
spell.welcomescreen.vacuum_blast.desc: Compresses air into an imploding pocket. Sucks surrounding targets inward before concussive detonation.
spell.welcomescreen.zephyr_crossbow.desc: Summons a hovering 3D gale crossbow beside your shoulder. Fires a hypersonic wind bolt penetrating all enemies in a 45-block line.
spell.welcomescreen.poison_area.desc: Coats the ground in a lingering cloud of toxic spores. Poisons any hostiles who dare tread inside.
spell.welcomescreen.entangling_roots.des: Commands grasping thorny vines to snare the target. Roots the enemy in place for several seconds.
spell.welcomescreen.healing_bloom.desc: Sprouts a mystical flower pulsing with restorative life. Instantly mends wounds and grants rapid regeneration.
spell.welcomescreen.thorn_armor.desc: Encases your body in razor-sharp enchanted briars. Reflects incoming melee damage back at attackers.
spell.welcomescreen.solar_beam.desc: Funnels radiant sunlight into a piercing beam. Sears all enemies caught in its trajectory.
spell.welcomescreen.insect_swarm.desc: Unleashes a furious swarm of stinging insects. Harasses and continuously stings the targeted target.
spell.welcomescreen.yggdrasil_staff.desc: Plants the living 3D wooden staff of the World Tree. Emits pulses that heal the caster while choking enemies with poisonous briars.
spell.welcomescreen.holy_light.desc: Invokes radiant grace to instantly restore 5 hearts. Cleanses all negative potion effects and ailments.
spell.welcomescreen.divine_shield.desc: Sanctifies you within an impenetrable golden dome. Grants total invulnerability to all damage for 4.5 seconds.
spell.welcomescreen.smite.desc: Strikes the target with a pillar of holy wrath. Deals double damage to undead abominations.
spell.welcomescreen.blessing_of_might.de: Empowers your spirit with martial divinity. Grants increased attack strength, absorption hearts, and swiftness.
spell.welcomescreen.consecration.desc: Hallows the ground beneath with an ancient golden seal. Burns enemies and slows undead walking across.
spell.welcomescreen.sword_of_damocles.de: Summons a colossal 12-meter 3D blade in the heavens that gathers holy energy and plunges into the earth. Releases massive earthquake shockwaves and radiates nearby enemies.
spell.welcomescreen.sun_chakram.desc: Flings a radiant spinning 3D solar chakram in an expanding orbital spiral. Cuts through enemies, ignites them, and blinds them with solar light.
spell.welcomescreen.void_walk.desc: Steps completely into the ethereal void. Grants total invisibility and immense traversing speed.
spell.welcomescreen.shadow_step.desc: Melts into the shadows to reappear behind the target. Grants brief invisibility and a lethal damage boost.
spell.welcomescreen.shadow_bolt.desc: Launches an orb of dark entropic void matter. Inflicts necrotic damage along with weakness and slowness.
spell.welcomescreen.drain_life.desc: Channels a dark siphon beam to the target. Drains health from the victim to continuously heal yourself.
spell.welcomescreen.fear.desc: Projects horrific nightmarish visions into nearby minds. Blinds and forces surrounding foes to flee in terror.
spell.welcomescreen.black_hole.desc: Creates a gravitational singularity that drags all enemies inward. Crushes trapped victims before collapsing violently.
spell.welcomescreen.abyssal_anchor.desc: Drops a colossal 3D void anchor from the sky. Slams into the earth and chains all nearby enemies to the seafloor so they cannot escape.
spell.welcomescreen.void_tentacle.desc: Summons a fluidly moving 3D eldritch void tentacle from a portal. Undulates forward, snatches an enemy, and violently slams them into the earth left and right!
spell.welcomescreen.blood_boil.desc: Superheats the bloodstream of all nearby hostiles. Inflicts intense internal rupture, slowness, and weakness.
spell.welcomescreen.blood_sacrifice.desc: Sacrifices 3 of your hearts in an unholy ritual. Instantly resets all spell cooldowns and grants berserk buffs.
spell.welcomescreen.hemorrhage.desc: Delivers a jagged arterial wound with coagulated blood. Causes severe bleeding that rapidly drains enemy health.
spell.welcomescreen.bloodlust.desc: Surrenders to a primal combat fury for 8 seconds. Grants massive attack speed, strength, and life-stealing strikes.
spell.welcomescreen.corpse_explosion.des: Detonates the target in a gory shockwave of bone and blood. Rips through nearby enemies with heavy shrapnel damage.
spell.welcomescreen.crimson_chalice.desc: Manifests a floating 3D gothic chalice of boiling blood. Drains the life force of surrounding living enemies into the chalice to heal you.
spell.welcomescreen.rocket_barrage.desc: Fires a rapid salvo of 6 micro-rockets from shoulder pods. Pelts the target zone with consecutive fiery detonations.
spell.welcomescreen.iron_spike.desc: Propels a high-velocity hardened steel javelin. Impales through armor and pins the victim to the earth.
spell.welcomescreen.magnetic_surge.desc: Discharges an intense electromagnetic pulse. Violently yanks all nearby entities inward and stuns them.
spell.welcomescreen.blade_flurry.desc: Conjures eight levitating razor-sharp steel daggers. Launches the blades forward in a devastating fan formation.
spell.welcomescreen.steel_aegis.desc: Deploys an orbital array of reinforced steel plates. Grants armor, knockback immunity, and deflects projectiles.
spell.welcomescreen.atomic_bomb.desc: Calls down a devastating nuclear missile that creates a massive crater and fires. Unleashes a 250-block shockwave that obliterates entities and radiates the area.
spell.welcomescreen.aegis_bastion.desc: Deploys a triad of three 3D spiked fortress shields orbiting you. Boosts resistance, deflects incoming projectiles, and knocks away approaching enemies.
spell.welcomescreen.gravitational_pull.d: Manifests a powerful gravitational singularity at the target location. Sucks all nearby enemies inward while continuously crushing them to the ground.
spell.welcomescreen.repulsion_field.desc: Releases an explosive kinetic antigravity blast. Repels all surrounding enemies and deflects away incoming projectiles with extreme force.
spell.welcomescreen.zero_gravity.desc: Suspends gravitational force across a wide radius. Traps nearby enemies in mid-air, rendering them completely weightless and unable to fight.
spell.welcomescreen.orbital_drop.desc: Inverts gravity beneath the targeted creature, launching it into the stratosphere. Then slams it down to earth for devastating impact damage.
spell.welcomescreen.gravity_crush.desc: Magnifies gravity tenfold within an area. Crushes hostiles flat to the earth with extreme slowness and heavy blunt damage.
spell.welcomescreen.time_stop.desc: Freezes the local timeline completely for several seconds. All enemies are frozen in place and unable to act while a ticking clock echoes.
spell.welcomescreen.time_warp.desc: Creates a temporal anchor at your current position and health. After running forward at high speed, rewinds time back to the anchor.
Supercharges your personal timeline for eight seconds. Grants immense haste, movement speed, and rapid health regeneration.
spell.welcomescreen.temporal_decay.desc: Fast-forwards the age of the target's physical body. Inflicts continuous necrotic decay damage, severe weakness, and slowness.
spell.welcomescreen.time_rift.desc: Tears open an unstable rift in spacetime. Emits periodic temporal distortion waves that damage and displace all nearby enemies.
spell.welcomescreen.chronos_hourglass.de: Suspends a colossal 3D golden hourglass in mid-air that slowly inverts. Traps all enemies in an absolute temporal stasis dome before rupturing time.
spell.welcomescreen.mirror_image.desc: Conjures three holographic illusion clones that circle around you. Confuses enemy aggro and tracking while dazzling nearby hostiles.
spell.welcomescreen.prismatic_beam.desc: Refracts radiant light through a spectral crystal lens. Fires a piercing rainbow laser in a long line that blinds and sears foes.
spell.welcomescreen.hallucination.desc: Projects bewildering optical mirages into the minds of all nearby hostiles. Scrambles enemy senses, causing them to fight each other in madness.
spell.welcomescreen.mirage_step.desc: Blinks forward instantaneously, leaving behind a shattered glass decoy. Blinds and disorients enemies standing at your arrival point.
spell.welcomescreen.deceptive_shroud.des: Envelops the caster in a light-bending holographic veil. Grants invisibility, movement speed, and spectral mirror defenses.
spell.welcomescreen.supernova.desc: Condenses stellar core plasma and detonates it in a blinding cosmic explosion. Knocks back enemies and decimates them with brilliant starfire.
spell.welcomescreen.starfall.desc: Calls down a sequential barrage of incandescent shooting stars from the sky. Bombards the target area with sparkling celestial detonations.
spell.welcomescreen.astral_beam.desc: Channels concentrated cosmic ray radiation in a long-range piercing lance. Blasts through armor and disintegrates foes with stellar heat.
spell.welcomescreen.nebula_surge.desc: Manifests an interstellar glowing cosmic nebula in the area. Restores health to allies while scorching and slowing trapped enemies.
spell.welcomescreen.constellation.desc: Weaves glowing celestial starlight bonds between multiple nearby enemies. Damages all linked targets simultaneously and amplifies incoming hits.
spell.welcomescreen.cosmic_realm.desc: Transports you to a cosmic void dimension with floating planets on a 50x50 asteroid. You can hide safely for 10 seconds before void instability begins dealing increasing damage.
spell.welcomescreen.stellar_core.desc: Creates a 3D gyroscopic core of orbiting cosmic rings and a pulsating star. Draws enemies into its center before collapsing in a supernova burst.
spell.welcomescreen.too_weak: You are too weak to sacrifice blood!

config.welcomescreen.title: Multiverse Powers
config.welcomescreen.expand.desc: Unfold every part of this page.
config.welcomescreen.collapse.desc: Fold every part of this page shut, so you only see the titles.
config.welcomescreen.apply.desc: Save every change on every tab; the screen stays open.
config.welcomescreen.steps: Hold shift for 10 steps at once.
config.welcomescreen.help: Click a title to fold it open or shut. Type a number or use - and +. Point at a line to read what it does.
config.welcomescreen.locked: The settings file is not open, so nothing can be saved here.
config.welcomescreen.server_decides: On this server the server’s own settings decide.
config.welcomescreen.defaults.desc: Put every number in the list back to what the mod has. Nothing is saved until you apply or save.
config.welcomescreen.cooldown.desc: How long you wait before you can use it again.

How much stamina a full bar holds.
config.welcomescreen.stamina.sprintDrain: Stamina sprinting costs per tick (20 ticks = 1 second).
config.welcomescreen.stamina.regenPerTic: Stamina that comes back per tick while you rest.
config.welcomescreen.stamina.regenDelayT: How long you have to rest before stamina comes back.
config.welcomescreen.stamina.exhaustionR: Stamina you need again before you can sprint after running out.

config.welcomescreen.green_lantern.light: Damage of one Light Bolt, in half hearts.
config.welcomescreen.green_lantern.shock: Damage of the shockwave in the middle, in half hearts; at its edge half of it.
config.welcomescreen.green_lantern.air_s: Damage of the plane's crash in the middle of the blast, in half hearts; at its edge half of it.
config.welcomescreen.green_lantern.light: Damage the flash does to the creatures of the dark (the undead, the Warden and the like), in half hearts; everything else is only blinded, slowed down and dazed.
Damage the creature in a bubble takes from the last slam when you pound it into the ground, in half hearts (the two slams before it deal a third of it each); what stands round it takes half.
screen.welcomescreen.title: Welkom
screen.welcomescreen.group_hint: Where your power comes from. Click to see its classes.
screen.welcomescreen.class_hint: How you use that power. Click a class to pick it.
screen.welcomescreen.notice.title: ⚠ Your class is not a cage ⚠
screen.welcomescreen.notice.body: Your class only decides your skill tree: how you grow and which powers you unlock. It never locks anything away. A Knight can still cast spells, a Wizard can still wear heavy armour, and anyone can use any weapon, potion or item from any group.
screen.welcomescreen.notice.short: ⚠ Your class only shapes your skill tree. Every weapon, spell and item stays open to you.
screen.welcomescreen.inventory.hint: Your class shapes your skill tree only - nothing is locked.
group.welcomescreen.warriors.lore: No gods, no spirits, no tricks - just a body trained to survive where others break.
group.welcomescreen.warriors.power: Your own body. Armour, weapons and endurance - no magic at all.
group.welcomescreen.warriors.pick: you want to be in the middle of the fight and simply hit hard.
group.welcomescreen.rangers.lore: They know the wild better than themselves: a bow, an animal, and the land itself.
group.welcomescreen.rangers.power: The wild. Range, animals, traps and knowing the land.
group.welcomescreen.rangers.pick: you like fighting from a distance, exploring, or having a companion.
group.welcomescreen.rogues.lore: They live off what others do not see. No honour, no rules - only what works.
group.welcomescreen.rogues.power: Stealth and cunning. Surprise, speed and dirty tricks.
group.welcomescreen.rogues.pick: you want to strike first, stay unseen and never fight fair.
group.welcomescreen.mages.lore: Arcane power, gained in four ways: learned, born, borrowed and taken.
group.welcomescreen.mages.power: Magic. Spells that hit hard from range, in a fragile body.
group.welcomescreen.mages.pick: you want big spells and can keep enemies away from you.
group.welcomescreen.faithful.lore: Their power does not come from themselves, but from what they believe.
group.welcomescreen.faithful.power: Faith. Healing, holy light and power against the undead.
group.welcomescreen.faithful.pick: you want to protect, heal, or hunt what should not exist.
group.welcomescreen.alchemists.lore: They rarely fight head-on - they win another way.
group.welcomescreen.alchemists.power: Potions and powders. Healing brews, poison, bombs and crafting.
group.welcomescreen.alchemists.pick: you like preparing, brewing and winning with the right mix.
group.welcomescreen.forsaken.lore: Wakes up with nothing, and no memory of who he was.
group.welcomescreen.forsaken.power: A little of everything: fragments of all six groups.
group.welcomescreen.forsaken.pick: you want no fixed role and the hardest possible start.
class.welcomescreen.knight.lore: The wall - still standing when everyone else falls.
class.welcomescreen.knight.special: Draws enemies to himself and blocks with shield and heavy armour.
class.welcomescreen.knight.pick: you want to survive anything and protect others.
class.welcomescreen.berserker.lore: The more he bleeds, the more dangerous he gets.
class.welcomescreen.berserker.special: Rage: hits harder the lower his health is.
class.welcomescreen.berserker.weak: Little defence - easy to push too far.
class.welcomescreen.halberdier.lore: Calm, patient, deadly - a long pole with a sharp end.
class.welcomescreen.halberdier.special: Long reach: hits enemies before they can hit back.
class.welcomescreen.halberdier.strong: Keeps enemies at a safe distance.
class.welcomescreen.halberdier.pick: you like controlled fighting and good positioning.
class.welcomescreen.duelist.lore: Wins by never getting hit - then strikes at the perfect moment.
class.welcomescreen.duelist.special: Dodges and parries, followed by a strong counter-attack.
class.welcomescreen.duelist.strong: Very hard to hit in a one-on-one fight.
class.welcomescreen.duelist.pick: you want skill and timing over raw strength.
class.welcomescreen.archer.lore: By the time something notices him, it is already too late.
class.welcomescreen.archer.special: Precise bow shots from long range.
class.welcomescreen.archer.strong: The most damage from a distance.
class.welcomescreen.archer.pick: you want to kill things before they reach you.
class.welcomescreen.beastmaster.lore: Never fights alone - something loyal and wild walks beside him.
class.welcomescreen.beastmaster.special: Animal companions that fight beside him and grow with him.
class.welcomescreen.beastmaster.weak: Weaker on his own when his animal falls.
class.welcomescreen.beastmaster.pick: you want a loyal animal partner.
class.welcomescreen.trapper.lore: Wins the fight before it starts. The ground is his weapon.
class.welcomescreen.trapper.special: Traps and snares that slow, catch and hurt enemies.
class.welcomescreen.trapper.strong: Very strong when prepared, great for defence.
class.welcomescreen.trapper.pick: you like planning ahead and luring enemies in.
class.welcomescreen.scout.lore: Sees everything before anyone else does.
class.welcomescreen.scout.special: Speed, sharp sight and spotting danger early.
class.welcomescreen.scout.strong: The fastest explorer, finds things first.
class.welcomescreen.scout.weak: Low damage in a straight fight.
class.welcomescreen.scout.pick: you love exploring and moving fast.
class.welcomescreen.assassin.lore: Invisible until it is too late. One mistake is enough.
class.welcomescreen.assassin.special: Sneak attacks from hiding that deal massive damage.
class.welcomescreen.assassin.strong: Kills a single target very fast.
class.welcomescreen.assassin.weak: Fragile if the first strike fails.
class.welcomescreen.assassin.pick: you want to strike once, hard, from the shadows.
class.welcomescreen.thief.lore: Every door has a lock, and every lock has a way in.
class.welcomescreen.thief.special: Lockpicking and stealing: more loot, fewer fights.
class.welcomescreen.thief.strong: Gets rich fast and avoids danger.
class.welcomescreen.thief.pick: you care more about treasure than about fighting.
class.welcomescreen.highwayman.lore: Waits in the shadow of the road.
class.welcomescreen.highwayman.special: Ambushes with crossbow shots and surprise attacks.
class.welcomescreen.highwayman.strong: A deadly first strike from range.
class.welcomescreen.highwayman.weak: Weak in a long, open fight.
class.welcomescreen.highwayman.pick: you like ambushes and a crossbow.
class.welcomescreen.infiltrator.lore: Walks in where nobody may enter, and leaves no trace.
class.welcomescreen.infiltrator.special: Sneaks past guards into places others cannot reach.
class.welcomescreen.infiltrator.pick: you want to sneak instead of fight.
class.welcomescreen.wizard.lore: Learned it all from books, and is never done learning.
class.welcomescreen.wizard.special: Many kinds of spells: fire, ice, light and more.
class.welcomescreen.sorcerer.lore: Born with magic nobody taught him.
class.welcomescreen.sorcerer.special: Fewer spells than a Wizard, but much stronger ones.
class.welcomescreen.sorcerer.weak: Few options, needs rest to recover.
class.welcomescreen.sorcerer.pick: you want pure, raw magic power.
class.welcomescreen.warlock.lore: Borrowed his power from something that is not human.
class.welcomescreen.warlock.special: Strong dark spells that always come with a price.
class.welcomescreen.warlock.pick: you like risk and dark power.
class.welcomescreen.necromancer.special: Raises the dead and curses enemies. Grows with every kill.
class.welcomescreen.necromancer.strong: An army of minions, stronger in long fights.
class.welcomescreen.necromancer.weak: Weak alone, and weak at the start.
class.welcomescreen.necromancer.pick: you want an army of the dead.
class.welcomescreen.cleric.lore: Without him, a hard fight falls apart.
class.welcomescreen.cleric.special: Healing and blessings for himself and others.
class.welcomescreen.cleric.strong: The best at keeping everyone alive.
class.welcomescreen.cleric.pick: you want to keep others standing.
class.welcomescreen.paladin.lore: A Knight's armour, but he fights with faith, not steel.
class.welcomescreen.paladin.special: Heavy armour plus holy power against evil.
class.welcomescreen.paladin.strong: Tough, and extra strong against undead.
class.welcomescreen.paladin.pick: you want to be a holy warrior.
class.welcomescreen.inquisitor.special: Extra strong against the undead and forbidden magic.
class.welcomescreen.inquisitor.pick: you want to hunt the undead and the dark.
class.welcomescreen.monk.lore: Needs no weapon and no armour - only discipline.
class.welcomescreen.monk.special: Fights with fists and speed, stronger without gear.
class.welcomescreen.monk.pick: you want a pure challenge without gear.
class.welcomescreen.apothecary.lore: Unremarkable, until the moment everyone needs him.
class.welcomescreen.plague_doctor.lore: Makes the enemy weaken itself before the fight starts.
class.welcomescreen.plague_doctor.specia: Poison and sickness that wear enemies down over time.
class.welcomescreen.bombardier.lore: Subtlety is not his strong suit.
class.welcomescreen.bombardier.special: Bombs that hit many enemies at once.
class.welcomescreen.bombardier.weak: Dangerous up close - also to himself.
class.welcomescreen.transmuter.special: Changes materials into other, more useful ones.
class.welcomescreen.transmuter.pick: you like crafting and building more than fighting.
class.welcomescreen.forsaken.lore: No group claims him. He does not know himself where he belongs.
class.welcomescreen.forsaken.special: Fragments of skills from every group.
class.welcomescreen.forsaken.strong: The most flexible: can grow into anything.
class.welcomescreen.forsaken.weak: Starts with nothing, no clear strength.
class.welcomescreen.forsaken.pick: you want the hardest start and total freedom.
screen.welcomescreen.construct_pick.help: Click one: a second later it strikes in front of you, shockwave and all.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.fist.desc: A giant fist smashes down out of the sky, knuckles first.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.hands.desc: Two giant hands clap together in front of you.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.fists.desc: Two giant fists bump knuckles in front of you.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.hammer.desc: A war hammer drops head first; sparks fly.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.emblem.desc: The lantern emblem stands up and falls flat on its face.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.anvil.desc: An anvil drops, squashes, throws sparks and hops once more.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.cymbals.des: Two cymbals crash together and ring.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.uppercut.de: A giant fist bursts up out of the ground.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.spikes.desc: Two rings of crystal spikes shoot up out of the ground.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.boot.desc: A boot stamps down heel first; the toe slaps after.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.weight.desc: A cartoon ton weight drops with a heavy squash.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.sword.desc: A sword drops point first and stays in the ground, quivering.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.rockets.des: Five rockets arc over your head and come down one after another.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.swatter.des: A fly swatter swings over your shoulder and slaps the ground flat.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.lantern.des: Your lantern drops, its handle swinging.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.safe.desc: A safe drops, its door flies open and money spills out.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.anchor.desc: An anchor drops; its chain comes down after it and piles up.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.mace.desc: A spiked ball tumbles down and rocks in the ground.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.barbell.des: A barbell drops on its plates and bounces.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.bell.desc: A bell drops on its rim and rings, its clapper swinging.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.meteor.desc: A burning meteor streaks in and slams into the ground.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.palm.desc: A giant open hand slaps the ground; its fingers drum after.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.gavel.desc: A judge's gavel strikes its block, and knocks once more.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.pickaxe.des: A pickaxe swings over your head and bites into the ground.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.trap.desc: The jaws of a bear trap snap shut.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.book.desc: A giant book flips its pages and slams shut.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.drum.desc: Two drumsticks strike a drum and play a roll.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.pillar.desc: A pillar bursts out of the ground and topples; its drums come apart.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.tnt.desc: A bundle of dynamite lands, its fuse burns down, and it blows up.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.piano.desc: A piano drops; its lids fly open and notes float up.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.brick.desc: A giant toy brick drops and bounces.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.stamp.desc: A rubber stamp stamps the lantern emblem into the ground.
